title: DJI Mavic 4 Pro Drone (Hasselblad 4/3)
purpose: Perpendicular nadir aerial photography and architectural top-down ground geometry with Hasselblad 4/3 clarity, flat planar perspective, and zero horizon.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: DJI Mavic 4 Pro Aerial Drone (Hasselblad 4/3 Sensor)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 100MP 4/3 CMOS sensor with Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution (HNCS)
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: ISO 100 base sensitivity with 10-bit D-Log M
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 14 stops dynamic range with natural color gradation
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Electronic rolling shutter with high-speed freeze up to 1/8000s

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: High-noon or raking morning sun casting crisp geometric ground shadows across terrain
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Clean natural daylight color, even edge-to-edge illumination, crisp shadow geometry without haze flare

surface_rendering: Ultra-fine planar detail: resolved pavement textures, crop furrows, architectural roof geometry, and water ripple facets
Hasselblad Natural Colour Solution: authentic organic earth tones, deep foliage greens, and neutral pavement grays
Clean edge acutance with zero digital sharpening halos or artifact smearing
depth_and_optics: Strict perpendicular 90-degree nadir top-down orientation with zero visible horizon
Corner-to-corner rectilinear geometry with zero fisheye or barrel distortion

execution_directive: Enforce straight-down nadir aerial photograph from a drone, flat graphic geometry of the ground, no horizon, crisp detail across the frame, clean natural color, shot on DJI Mavic 4 Pro.
